text: Children of the objects categorized using this method do not automatically belong to the categories defined using this method. You must manually update each child object to change its category. Users must restart their sessions to See any changes. 1. “Open the Teamcenter rich client. 2. “Choose Edit—>Options and locate the AW_FullTextSearch_TypeCategories preference. Set the Values field to the full value of all categories. For example, the Files, Documents, Parts, and Changes categories default values could be set a5 follows: Files:MSExcelX,MSPowerPointX,MSWNordX, PDF, Text, JPEG Documents:DocumentRevision, RequirementSpec Revision Parts:DesignRevision, PartRevision Changes:ChangeItemRevision Warning: This method of changing categories may cause unexpected results. Internal names of objects are cryptic and the Value field content is not checked for spelling or other errors. Category names are not localized.
